rounds.text: Conceded: [E1], [E6], [E7], [E8], [E9], [E12], [E68]. While the company shows moderate current profitability, the long-term evidence reveals a persistent inability to generate superior returns for shareholders. The median return on equity over the last decade is a lackluster 8% [E26], which has only marginally improved to a median of 9% over five years [E27]. This trend is further underscored by the explicit flagging of a low three-year return on equity of 9.99% [E61]. Most critically, the company’s capital efficiency is significantly inferior to its peers, with an ROCE of 14.36% compared to a sector benchmark of 30.47% [E10]. Finally, the absence of any dividend yield [E4] means investors are not being compensated for holding a stock that consistently fails to deliver high-tier returns on capital.
